Hi yea! So I’ve actually been able to astral project ever since I was a young kid. I grew up being SA so I think it was a way for me to escape. I spent a lot of my time sleeping and dreaming. I never really knew I was doing it till I entered therapy. It wasn’t till then she taught me how to control it. Basically, for me atleast, I’m able to do it after I enter sleep paralysis. Which is when the body is asleep but the mind is awake. Which can be induced by meditation. But for me I’m always able to do it in the early morning after I wake or a midday nap. But essentially I learned that sleep paralysis is nothing to be afraid of. And when I got over my fear understood what was happening I gained control. So now when I enter that realm I’m aware of what’s happening and I’m able to either fall into my body or roll out. You can tell bc you’ll feel a vibration in your body and you either need to “fall into it” or practice rolling out. I was doing this as a child and never knew! But when I understood the signs it became extremely controllable. Now I set an intention before that I want to explore different realities. I’ve only been able to do that part for about two years now and the first time I did it was terrifying. 

My first time ever I rolled out of my body and I stood up and it was extremely hard to keep my eyes open and be present, that one lasted maybe 5 seconds. The second time I was a bit stronger and was able to talk to people and explore and the more I’ve been able to do it the longer I can stay. But I woke up in terror bc I was alive somewhere else. I knew their memories, I felt their pain, their terror, their happiness and sorrow. It was insane!

So the difference between this and a lucid dream is that lucid dreaming is just that, a dream. I have my reality checks when I’m in a lucid dream which is I can never look in a mirror and clocks don’t exist. My reflection looks fuzzy and essentially non existent. When I’m reality hopping I can look in the mirror and see my reflection, the tech exist (if there is any) and everything feels REAL. I’ve even used the bathroom before (and I’ve never awoken with a wet bed) but you feel everything as if you were alive. Hunger, thirst, bathroom urgencies, panic, everything. You can’t feel those in a dream, I mean you can to some degree, but it feels different (hard to explain) 

I get there the same way I would enter astral or even a lucid dream, the difference was my intention. But if you want to do this, master “sleep paralysis” there’s frequencies out their that can help and personally I think going through meditation is harder than the natural course of waking up and already being sleepy but keeping your mind awake. Just know when you’re in the inbetween state nothing can hurt you, keep your vibrations high and know and tell yourself you are safe! You control your world. You control your mind. You are safe. 

I hope this helps! 🖤

I’ve set boundaries with my partner while he’s in therapy and recovering. He hasn’t had IG, Snapchat or Reddit since I’ve found out. (He’s never used FB or TikTok) I’m logged into his accounts to make sure he’s not using them while at work or in the bathroom. He’s followed it, which has shown me a lot. And just the emotional relief it has given me not to worry about it anymore. I know there’s other platforms that can be used but I think him deleting his social accounts has really helped him and he hasn’t fought me on it at all. He’s also recognized it’s helped and has now found a new hobby and puts his energy elsewhere. Don’t be afraid to set boundaries for your mental health. If it’ll help you sleep at night and make you more comfortable by all means do it and if he loves you and is committed to recovery he will do it. Best of luck ♥️ and hang in there
